shortDescription: Manage Jenkins credentials and domains through API

options.name: api_uri
options.description: Link to Github API.

options.name: appID
options.description: GitHub App ID.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the credential or domain.

options.name: exc_hostname
options.description: List of hostnames to exclude from scope. If a hostname appears in both this list and O(inc_hostname), the hostname is excluded.

options.name: exc_hostname_port
options.description: List of host:port to exclude from scope. If a hostname and port appears in both this list and O(inc_hostname_port), it is excluded.

options.name: exc_path
options.description: List of URL paths to exclude. If a path is also matched by O(exc_path), it is excluded. If you exclude a subpath of a path previously included, that subpath alone is excluded.

options.name: file_path
options.description: File path to secret file (for example O(type=file) or O(type=certificate)). For O(type=certificate), this can be a V(.p12) or V(.pem) file.

options.name: force
options.description: Force update if the credential already exists, used with O(state=present). If set to V(true), it deletes the existing credential before creating a new one. Always returns RV(ignore:changed=true).

options.name: id
options.description: The ID of the Jenkins credential or domain. When generating a new token, do not pass O(id). It is generated automatically.

options.name: inc_hostname
options.description: List of hostnames to include in scope.

options.name: inc_hostname_port
options.description: List of V(host:port) to include in scope.

options.name: inc_path
options.description: List of URL paths to include when matching credentials to domains. B(Matching is hierarchical): subpaths of excluded paths are also excluded, even if explicitly included.

options.name: jenkins_password
options.description: Jenkins password for token creation. Required if O(type=token).

options.name: jenkins_user
options.description: Jenkins user for authentication.

options.name: location
options.description: Location of the credential. Either V(system) or V(folder). If O(location=folder) then O(url) must be set to V(<jenkins-server>/job/<folder_name>).

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the token to generate. Required if O(type=token). When generating a new token, do not pass O(id). It is generated automatically. Creating two tokens with the same name generates two distinct tokens with different RV(token_uuid) values. Replacing a token with another one of the same name requires deleting the original first using O(force=True).

options.name: owner
options.description: GitHub App owner.

options.name: passphrase
options.description: SSH passphrase if needed.

options.name: password
options.description: Password for credentials types that require it (for example O(type=user_and_passs) or O(type=certificate)).

options.name: private_key_path
options.description: Path to private key file for PEM certificates or GitHub Apps.

options.name: schemes
options.description: List of schemes (for example V(http) or V(https)) to match.

options.name: scope
options.description: Jenkins credential domain scope. Deleting a domain scope deletes all credentials within it.

options.name: secret
options.description: Secret text (used when O(type=text)).

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the credential.

options.name: token
options.description: Jenkins API token. Required unless O(type=token).

options.name: type
options.description: Type of the credential or action.

options.name: url
options.description: Jenkins server URL.

options.name: username
options.description: Username for credentials types that require it (for example O(type=ssh_key) or O(type=user_and_pass)).
